notes: ELLA Zero is now XiteAI OS1. Same app, new name, and updates now take care of themselves.

changelog.headline: Introducing XiteAI OS1

sections.title: A new name
items: ELLA Zero is now XiteAI OS1. Nothing about how it works changes, and if you already had it installed, this update applies itself like any other — your chats, memory, notes and settings carry over exactly as they were.

sections.title: What it does
items: Talk to it with no wake word, or type — it hears you, remembers what you tell it, and recalls it later without being asked, with the real date attached to every fact.
Live markets, weather, news, and real web search for anything current.
Calendar, tasks, reminders, alarms, timers and Focus sessions, all managed by voice or text.
Notes, a real file workspace, and reading your actual documents — Word, PDF, Excel, PowerPoint.
Chess against a real engine with a teacher mode, plus jokes, riddles, and running tallies it keeps on its own.
Your devices, one tree: pair every machine on your wifi with a nine-digit code, no account or cloud involved.

sections.title: Updates that take care of themselves
items: New versions download quietly in the background and install the next time it restarts.
A typical update is a few megabytes, not hundreds, because only the files that actually changed are sent.
Every file is checked against a signed list before anything on your PC is touched, and if a new version fails to start, the previous one is put back automatically.

changelog.data_safety: Your chats, memory, notes, portfolio and settings stay exactly as they are. Updates only replace the app's own program files. Nothing you have created is touched or deleted.
